visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The walk and the cast are retaken with steady light because their first takes turned the plate dark in long stretches; the walk loops 32-91 and the halting-palm cast holds 24-84. The hit flinches and recovers over the dark plates at 74-97. The defend skips a smudged frame at 15, snaps into the spool guard and bridges the dark plates at 35-63 into the deeper crouch. The death skips 31-35, where the spool flips onto the slinger's head. Idle, attack and ranged are used as generated.
